rv.q: Last but not least, How High The Moon looks absolutely fabulous thanks to scenic designer Thomas Meleck’s detailed side-by-side family homes, Cameron Massey’s vivid lighting, and Michael Mullen’s pitch-perfect period costumes, with Max Gorbachev providing an effective sound design of 1950s tunes and script-inspired effects along the way.
Tightly directed by Asaad Kelada and clocking in at under 90 minutes, the intensity of the family drama never feels forced or telegraphed.
